counterfactual_missing_items: No other obvious physical abnormalities were noted
Routine blood examinations revealed no pathological findings
decisive_items: Two osteolytic lesions identified on the right frontoparietal skull
Subepidermal infiltrate consisting of large cells with kidney-shaped nuclei
The infiltrate stained positively for CD1A
response.rationale: C1 is a more specific diagnosis than R2 due to the presence of osteolytic lesions, which is a known complication of Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
